title: Microsoft Paint 3D was AAA.
author: Ok_Truth_324
selftext:
Before you smite me. Windows threw it around like it was halo ok. This is relevant because it's optimized. If your game isn't optimized like MS Paint youre losing. 

I spent months making 1 building and guess what. It looks like crap. But its optimized for pvp. On that note, is everybody using UE5 or unity or is there custom engine guys out there. I'm looking for more optimization ideas. I reduced poly count. I was at like 91mil poly and reduced it to like 7.9mil maintaining full detail. 

I don't wanna use UE5 or unity. Because I'm that guy. 

I've been testing methods on assets with high polygon counts. I was able to completely get rid of polygons and shrink a 3mil polygon asset to 48kb give or take.

comments.author: GigaTerra
comments.body:
The thing about rendering is the draw calls, not so much poly count. Consider GPU instancing, if you took one 200,000 polygon block and used GPU instancing you could go over 100 million polygons easy, because it is the same block you are rendering over and over. This is how games would render large asteroid fields for example,

>I've been testing methods on assets with high polygon counts. I was able to completely get rid of polygons and shrink a 3mil polygon asset to 48kb give or take.

Have you heard of impostors? The idea is to render your 3D models to sprites, basically turning any model into 2 triangles.
